note: Two Critical pull_request_target paths were judged false: the Frogbot scan runs under the approval-gated environment `frogbot` at the approved head commit, and the label-gated test workflow runs only when a maintainer applies `safe to test`, at the labelled head commit (`head.sha || github.sha`, the fallback never applying under pull_request_target), so both hold as maintainer-approved Medium paths at most.
